name: Curse These Fat Fingers
summary: Hansel Heavyhands, in the Searing Gorge, can no longer dish out beatings as before, thanks to swollen fingers. Hansel asks you to go pound the heavy war golems for them.

sections.title: Fingers Like Sausages
sections.body: Hansel Heavyhands says the climate in the Gorge, with its thin air, makes Hansel's fingers swell until they resemble huge Thelsamar blood sausages. As a result, Hansel cannot deliver beatings the way Hansel used to, and needs you to see to Hansel's business instead.

sections.title: First on the List
sections.body: First on Hansel's agenda are the heavy war golems of the Gorge, which Hansel wants pounded hard. Twenty of them are to be destroyed. They roam the areas around the Cauldron, and you return to Hansel once enough have fallen.

aliases: who gives curse these fat fingers
faq.answer: Someone in the Searing Gorge whose swollen fingers keep them from fighting, so they ask you to do the pounding.

faq.q: Why can Hansel not fight the golems personally?
faq.answer: Hansel blames the climate and the thin air of the Gorge for swelling their fingers, which they liken to huge Thelsamar blood sausages.

faq.q: What foes must be dealt with?
Where are the heavy war golems located?
faq.answer: They roam the areas around the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge.

attribution: Classic quest text: Curse These Fat Fingers
